title: lodash@4.16.6 breaks build 🚨
body:
Hello lovely humans, [lodash](https://www.npmjs.com/package/lodash) just published its new version 4.16.6.
State Failing tests :rotating_light:
Dependency lodash
New version 4.16.6
Type dependency
This version is **covered** by your **current version range** and after updating it in your project **the build went from success to failure**. As lodash is a direct dependency of this project **this is very likely breaking your project right now**. If other packages depend on you it’s very likely also breaking them. I recommend you give this issue a very high priority. I’m sure you can resolve this 💪 Of course this could just be a false positive, caused by a flaky test suite, or third parties that are currently broken or unavailable, but that would be another problem I’d recommend working on.
